ThinkByte: Pavan, Vigarna Ramesh, Harsha Thota, Charan
Abhithevictore
Key Takeaways
The meeting focused on evaluating current campaign performance and exploring new strategies to improve lead quality and conversion rates.
Key problems addressed included low lead quality, ineffective targeting, and high costs with minimal conversions, particularly due to irrelevant traffic.
Follow-up actions involve developing custom audiences, conducting keyword research, and exploring alternative platforms like LinkedIn and Google Ads.
The team decided to optimize budget allocation, improve targeting, and test new advertising strategies to enhance lead quality and conversion rates.

Evaluate campaign targeting and effectiveness
Implement audience targeting based on research

Data Utilization and Sharing
Lack of effective data sharing, utilization for campaign optimization, affecting ability to improve targeting strategies.
Decisions: Use past lead data to inform audience targeting, create custom, lookalike audiences for better engagement.
Share past lead data, insights for better targeting, campaign effectiveness.
Ensure relevant data is shared efficiently among team members for coordinated efforts.
Targeting and Audience Segmentation
Irrelevant traffic due to broad targeting, leading to unqualified leads.
Segment audiences to improve targeting precision, relevance of ad campaigns.
Explore segmenting audience by specific interests, platforms to improve targeting.
Decisions: Create custom audiences, lookalike audiences from existing data enhance targeting accuracy.
Lead Quality Improvement
Improve lead quality by refining targeting, messaging strategies to attract more relevant potential customers.
Low quality leads despite significant budget spend, with many leads unable to afford services or irrelevant.
Decisions: Focus on creating ad sets targeting specific interests, platforms to enhance lead relevance.
Conduct keyword research, testing for Google Ads to reach higher-intent audiences.
Creative and Messaging Strategy
Existing creatives may attract irrelevant audiences, focusing too much on funding aspects rather than business growth.
Decisions: Develop creatives emphasizing business growth objectives rather than funding, aligning better with target market needs.
Adjust ad creatives, messaging to attract more qualified leads, align with audience interests.
Test different ad messaging strategies to identify what resonates with target audience.
Platform Exploration
Current platforms not delivering qualified leads, indicating need to diversify advertising strategies.
Leverage Google Ads for better intent-based targeting, focusing on high-intent keywords.
Test new platforms like Google Ads, LinkedIn to enhance audience targeting and lead quality.
Decisions: Explore Shopify ads, LinkedIn for targeted outreach to specific business owners, like Shopify store owners.
Campaign Performance Evaluation
High cost per conversion with minimal results, indicating inefficient ad spend.
Implement custom audience targeting, lookalike audiences for better engagement, relevance.
Decisions: Redirect efforts towards improving lead quality, conversion rates by refining targeting strategies.
Review current campaign performance, low lead quality, explore strategies improvement.
Low quality leads, with only one out of nine leads being relevant despite significant spending of 8,000 rupees.
Budget Allocation and Optimization
Decisions: Consider reducing budgets for underperforming campaigns, focusing on better-performing strategies.
Explore different platforms like LinkedIn, Google Ads for potential better ROI.
Ineffective budget allocation leading to high costs without substantial conversions, prompting need for better strategy.
Evaluate optimize campaign budgets improve return investment.
Pain Point
Three out of nine individuals mentioned they cannot afford the fund and are ineligible due to lacking a website or resources.
Expressed concern about already spending a significant amount of money and doubted that increasing the budget would solve the problem.
